blurb:
BRAND NEW THIS SUMMER - Discover Banff beyond the postcard views on this guided Tasting Trail through the town’s hidden gems, local pubs, breweries, and cocktail spots. 

Part historical walking tour, part progressive tasting experience, this afternoon blends mountain history, storytelling, local legends, and plenty of laughs along the way.

You’ll sip craft beers, cocktails, and local favourites while exploring the stories that shaped Banff... from colourful characters and legendary tales to the unique culture of this iconic mountain town. With delicious snacks included at select stops, it’s like a pub crawl… just with better stories, more flavour, and a LOT of personality.

Educational enough to justify the indulgence. Fun enough to forget you’re technically learning.
